readerCopy.headline: Someone with more leverage may not share your plan.
readerCopy.body:
Another person may have the signature, money, access, or final say you need. They can be reasonable and still want different terms. A plan may stall because the person who benefits from the current arrangement has little reason to change it. More effort from you does not automatically change their incentive.

Jupiter opposing Pluto can make the power imbalance harder to ignore. Do not turn a blocked yes into a verdict on your worth. Find what can actually be negotiated, what cannot, and what the remaining terms cost you. At some point, the problem may not be your effort.
